buttons.label: Stage frost rivalry
buttons.script: const imp=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='cinder-imp'); const frost=[...objects].find(o=>o.definition?.id==='cinder-rival'); const p=imp.position; frost.entity.rigidbody.teleport(p.x+1.2,p.y+0.35,p.z); frost.testClip=null; imp.resumeBehavior();
